tagline: Chain the Hundred Fists, mark the meridians — they're already dead

featuredCards.title: Hokuto: Hundred-Fist Rush
featuredCards.caption: Four copies, and every one already in the discard buys another strike in the same combat. The chain keeps hitting after the first blow lands.

featuredCards.title: Hokuto: Dragon Form Breathing Technique
featuredCards.caption: When they hurt your ally, the form answers — every HOKUTO card swings harder for the turn. Vengeance, mechanically enforced.

featuredCards.title: Death Omen Star
featuredCards.caption: At 5 health the star rises: three Hokuto cards return from the discard, and the chain reloads exactly when the deck should be dying.

featuredCards.title: YOU ARE ALREADY DEAD!
featuredCards.caption: Uncancelable. Half of everything they dealt you last turn, returned in one breath. The line every table sees coming and still cannot stop.
